executive_readiness_summary.rule13_trigger_rationale: No high-risk client-side behavioural profiling, session replay, or automated decisioning scripts were observed on initial page load.
key_observed_strengths: Website Automations, AI & Profiling (Sec 6 / Rule 13(2)): Total client-side automations detected: 0 (Marketing/CRM: 0, CDP/Tag Managers: 0, Session Replay/Heatmaps: 0, AI Chatbots/Widgets: 0, Ad Pixels: 0, Early field listeners: false).
Children's Data Protection (Sec 9 / Rules 10-11): Youth/child audience indicators: true; Age-gate / verifiable parental consent signal: true; Active behavioural/ad pixels on page: 0.
Cross-Border Sub-Processors (Sec 16 / Rule 15): Observed 0 external third-party domain(s) receiving client network requests ().
priority_readiness_enhancements: Notice & Transparency (Sec 5 / Rule 3): Publish a standalone, itemised Section 5 / Rule 3 Privacy Notice detailing personal data categories, specific purposes, DPO/Grievance contact, 90-day grievance SLA (Rule 14(3)), and English + Eighth Schedule language toggle.

Consent & Dark-Pattern Symmetry (Sec 6 / Rules 3-4): Remove all `checked` attributes from optional consent checkboxes, deploy a Section 6-aligned consent banner with equal-prominence `Accept` and `Reject Non-Essential` buttons, and expose a persistent footer trigger to withdraw consent with ease comparable to granting it.

Reasonable Security Safeguards (Sec 8(5) / Rule 6): Configure `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload`, a strict `Content-Security-Policy`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, and retain server/access logs for a minimum of 1 year under Rule 8(3) and the Seventh Schedule.

Grievance Redressal & 90-Day SLA (Sec 13 / Rule 14(3)): Display the Grievance Officer / DPO designation, official email, postal address, and an explicit statement that grievances are resolved within a period not exceeding 90 days in accordance with Section 13 and Rule 14(3).
